title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description: TechNova is hiring backend engineers to build the APIs that power our logistics platform. You will design REST endpoints with FastAPI, model data in PostgreSQL, and keep latency low under heavy order traffic. We care about clean schemas, automated tests, and code that other engineers enjoy reading. This is a fresher-friendly role with a structured mentorship programme.

title: Software Engineer (Java Services)
description: Join FinEdge's payments core team writing Java services that settle millions of transactions every day. You will build Spring Boot microservices, model money movement in MySQL, and harden endpoints behind JWT authentication. Pairing, code review, and blunt-but-kind feedback are part of how we work here. Ideal for engineers with internship experience who want production scale.

title: Backend Engineer (Go)
description: Streamly's realtime ingest team needs engineers comfortable with Go and concurrency. You will write gRPC services that funnel clickstream events into Kafka and Redis-backed hot storage. We ship weekly, keep services small, and measure everything with Prometheus. Strong CS fundamentals matter more to us than framework trivia.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (MERN)
description: OrbitHire is a hiring-platform startup looking for generalists who can move across the stack with confidence. You will build React interfaces backed by Node.js and Express APIs, with MongoDB as the primary datastore and GraphQL where it simplifies the client. Expect to own features end to end from Figma handoff to deployment. We value readable code and honest estimates over heroics.

title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: PixelForge builds analytics dashboards used by retail teams across India, and we want them to feel fast and accessible. You will craft component libraries in React and TypeScript, style them with Tailwind, and squeeze performance out of Vite builds. Accessibility is a release blocker here, not an afterthought. You will pair with designers who actually ship.

title: UI Engineer (Angular)
description: MediTrack's patient-scheduling product needs engineers who take browser performance seriously. You will develop Angular single-page applications, manage predictable state with RxJS patterns, and keep layouts responsive from phones to ward monitors. We run accessibility audits every sprint and treat regressions as bugs. Healthcare domain experience is welcome but not required.

title: Web Developer (Fresher)
description: BrightLeaf is a small digital agency taking on its first cohort of graduate developers. You will build marketing sites and content pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, then wire them to simple form backends. Mentorship is hands-on: your lead reviews every pull request and explains the why. If you can write clean markup and love making pages pixel-perfect, apply.

title: Frontend Engineer (Vue)
description: CartWheel's storefront team ships the shopping experience for over 200 emerging brands. You will develop Vue.js components with the Composition API, style them with Vite-powered tooling, and optimise conversion-critical pages for slow 3G connections. We A/B test relentlessly and expect engineers to read the results. Experience with e-commerce or performance budgets is a plus.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
description: CloudSpire is looking for full-stack engineers to build our customer-facing control plane. You will develop server-rendered Next.js applications with TypeScript front ends and Django REST backends backed by PostgreSQL. Deployment happens continuously through GitHub Actions. We want people who write tests before merging and can explain trade-offs to non-engineers.

title: Data Analyst
description: DataBridge helps consumer brands understand their customers, and our analysts sit close to the decisions. You will query warehouses with SQL, clean and join datasets in pandas, and explain trends through Tableau dashboards that business teams actually open. We expect rigorous definitions of metrics and healthy skepticism toward vanity numbers. Strong written communication matters as much as code.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: VoltRetail's growth team runs hundreds of experiments a quarter and needs analysts who can keep up. You will build Power BI models, write warehouse SQL for cohort analysis, and design A/B test readouts that survive executive review. You will partner directly with product managers who value clarity over jargon. Prior internship experience with dashboards is ideal.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Lakehouse Labs treats data models as software. You will build reliable transformation layers with dbt, orchestrate refreshes in Airflow, and keep BigQuery costs in check with sensible partitioning. We maintain a style guide, review every model change, and expect documentation alongside migrations. Prior experience with dimensional modelling will set you apart.

title: Data Scientist
description: CropSense builds forecasting models for agricultural supply chains, and accuracy directly affects farmers' incomes. You will prototype machine learning models in scikit-learn, evaluate them with proper cross-validation, and translate findings into recommendations that field teams can act on. Domain data is messy, so curiosity matters. We publish internal write-ups of every model decision.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: NeuraStack trains large language models for Indian-language search, and we need engineers fluent in modern deep learning. You will fine-tune transformer models with PyTorch, experiment with retrieval-augmented pipelines, and serve low-latency inference endpoints. Expect rigorous experiment tracking and honest ablations rather than hype. Publication record is nice; working code is required.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Sightline builds inspection cameras for factories, and our models must work on the edge with tight latency budgets. You will develop convolutional and transformer-based vision models in PyTorch, curate labelled image datasets, and deploy quantised graphs to embedded hardware. You should be comfortable reading research papers and reproducing results. Prior robotics or embedded exposure is a strong plus.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: ShipYard runs platform infrastructure for forty product teams, and reliability is our product. You will automate deployments with Terraform, harden CI/CD pipelines, and keep Kubernetes clusters healthy across environments. We rotate on-call with humane escalation policies and blameless postmortems. Scripting in bash or Python and genuine Linux curiosity are essential.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: PayLoop's SRE team owns uptime for a payments API that merchants depend on around the clock. You will define SLIs and error budgets, build dashboards in Prometheus and Grafana, and automate incident response tooling. Expect deep debugging of production systems and a culture that writes runbooks before pages. Experience with Nginx tuning and cloud load balancers is valued.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: NimbusGrid helps mid-market companies exit data centres, and migrations are the heart of the job. You will design AWS landing zones, automate them with Terraform, and move workloads with minimal downtime. You will also coach client engineers on IAM hygiene and cost controls. AWS certifications are appreciated; practical hands-on accounts for more.

title: Azure Cloud Associate
description: Vaulta is a regulated fintech migrating its stack to Azure with strict compliance requirements. You will provision infrastructure as code, containerise workloads with Docker, and keep networking private and audited. You will work alongside security engineers who review every change. Ideal for someone early in their cloud career who learns quickly and documents carefully.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description: QualityFirst believes testing is engineering, not a gate at the end. You will build browser automation with Playwright, keep the suite fast enough to run on every pull request, and instrument flaky tests until they are trustworthy. You will also pair with developers on testability of new features. Prior experience with pytest or Java test frameworks is welcome.

title: QA Engineer (Manual + Automation)
description: TrustCart's checkout flow touches real money, so our QA engineers earn their keep. You will write detailed test cases covering edge conditions, execute exploratory sessions, and automate critical paths with Selenium. You will file crisp bug reports that include logs and reproduction steps. Commerce domain exposure helps; meticulous attention to detail is mandatory.

title: iOS Engineer
description: DriftChat is a messaging app with a fanatical focus on smooth animations and offline reliability. You will build Swift interfaces, manage state cleanly, and profile jank until scrolling feels effortless on three-year-old phones. We release weekly and watch crash rates like hawks. Side projects or open-source Swift contributions carry real weight here.

title: Android Developer (Kotlin)
description: Saarthi's learning app reaches students on low-end Android devices over patchy networks. You will develop Kotlin screens with Jetpack Compose, cache content for offline study, and integrate REST APIs with sensible error states. Performance budgets are strict: if it heats the phone, it does not ship. Prior Kotlin or Java Android projects are essential.

title: Junior Developer (Support Engineering)
description: EchoDesk runs a support-engineering programme designed for absolute beginners. You will reproduce customer issues, write small fixes in Python, maintain internal tools, and improve documentation as you go. Rotations through our API and integrations teams happen every four months. We hire for curiosity and clear writing; technical depth comes from the programme.
